source: Four user-supplied Tracker screenshots in the project conversation. Image 4 supersedes the earlier asymmetric phone placement; original Tracker project and image files are not stored in the repository.
referenceFrame: Rear-axle center; forward positive, left positive, up positive.

wheelbaseM.annotation: 0.173 m between front and rear wheel centers

frontOverhangM.annotation: 3.894E-2 m from front axle to front end

cameraHeightM.annotation: 9.924E-2 m from floor to camera sensor/lens

cameraDistanceBehindFrontM.annotation: 0.151 m horizontal distance from front end to camera sensor/lens

trackWidthM.annotation: 0.127 m between left and right front tire centers
trackWidthM.usage: Descriptive metadata only; not full outside width, rear track width, or a swept-steering envelope.

widthM.annotation: 0.144 m overall width with the phone moved to a symmetric lateral position, as confirmed by the user
widthM.usage: Centered collision rectangle with 0.072 m half-width; distinct from the 0.127 m tire-center spacing.

cameraLeftM.annotation: 5.090E-2 m from the longitudinal car centerline to the camera sensor/lens
cameraLeftM.sign: Positive left: the front bumper points to image left, so the lower side of this top-view image is the car's left. The lens lies on that lower side.
cameraLeftM.usage: Lens offset, not phone-center offset; centering the phone does not center its lens.

unconfirmed.cameraPitchDownDeg: Lens optical-axis downward tilt relative to the floor; the phone outline alone does not establish calibrated optical-axis alignment.
unconfirmed.cameraYawLeftDeg: Lens optical-axis heading relative to the car, positive left.
unconfirmed.coneFlange: Verify enclosing collision footprint, including any square flange beyond the confirmed 200 mm diameter.

notes: Values are transcribed from the displayed Tracker labels, not inferred from unlabeled pixel distances.
The camera sensor reference is the lens position identified by the user, not the phone center or phone top edge.
The derivation treats 0.151 m as a horizontal rearward distance from the same front-end reference used for front overhang, as described by the user.
For image 4, the user moved the phone to a symmetric lateral position without changing its front-end distance; the 0.151 m setback and derived 0.06094 m forward offset are retained.
Camera height remains the earlier 0.09924 m measurement; image 4 is a top view and does not independently remeasure height or optical-axis pitch/yaw.
Displayed digits do not establish physical accuracy. Perspective, reference-plane differences, lens distortion and scale calibration remain measurement uncertainty.
No commissioning flag is changed by these geometry measurements.
